tooltipLines.leftText: Equip: Your damaging spells have a chance to stir the Void near your target, erupting for 46,199 Shadow damage split among nearby enemies. You siphon energy from the Void, gaining 379 Intellect for 10 sec.

Use: Mark your target for execution, increasing your Haste by 286 for 20 sec. While the target is marked, each of your attacks against them grants an additional 20 Critical Strike, as the Void urges you to finish the kill, up to a maximum of 307 Critical Strike. (2 |4Min:Min; Cooldown)
Equip: Your attacks have a chance to release toxic parasites that burst around you, dealing 17,885 Nature damage split among nearby enemies and healing you for 13,698.

On Use: Activate the array and generate a Voidstone Barrier, absorbing 71,596 damage for the next 10 sec.

The barrier is further empowered by 1% per unique gem color you have socketed. (3 |4Min:Min; Cooldown)
Use: Teaches you how to craft Voidstone Shielding Array.
Tormented Tantalum, Mote of Pure Void (20), Sin'dorei Lens (12), Dusk-Shrouded Stone (12), Spark (2)
Use: Add this Decor to your House Chest.
